phases.objective: Define and verify a fail-closed Ed25519 schema attestation that binds the three governed migrations, exact same-cycle schema readback, deployed runtime parity, database fingerprint, signer provenance, freshness, and public-key fingerprint without accessing a live database or committing signing material.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: A synthetically signed exact schema subject verifies only when migration ledger evidence, readback counts, runtime parity, database identity, signer policy, public-key fingerprint, and freshness all match; production readiness and operational authority remain false.
steps: Build a canonical secret-free schema subject from the three exact governed migration ledger rows.
Bind the subject to the exact repository source commit and deployed runtime SHA.
Bind the same-cycle readback to 15 compatible tables, three views, 52 runtime columns, 22 index positions, and three disabled tools.
Hash the normalized migration and readback evidence independently before hashing the complete subject.
Generate an ephemeral Ed25519 key pair inside the test process and sign only the canonical signature payload.
Verify the signature with the public JWK and require the exact allowed key fingerprint, signer identity, issuer, freshness, signing delay, and readback duration.
Reject private JWK input, tampered subjects, invalid signatures, stale evidence, runtime drift, database mismatch, incomplete readback, incorrect ledger mode, and sensitive fields.
Prove no live database access, migration execution, provider dispatch, deployment, Production mutation, authority grant, or committed private key occurred.
assertions: Schema verification becomes true only after a valid Ed25519 signature over the exact canonical subject digest.
All three migration filenames, checksums, statement counts, apply modes, success statuses, and ledger evidence digests are required.
Runtime source and deployed SHA parity is mandatory when the policy requires it.
Readback must prove all expected objects and default-off tools with zero provider calls, credential reads, external writes, or secrets.
A valid schema signature does not set production_ready, grant authority, authorize migration apply, or permit provider dispatch.
No private key material or live schema evidence is committed by this change.

phases.objective: Operational signing requires a separately governed signer and live same-cycle database readback.
Signer rotation, transparency logging, and retry handling belong to the later operational signing vehicle.
No live database or provider canary is executed by this contract slice.
Production schema verification remains false until live apply, same-cycle readback, and an authorized external signature complete.
